style.lead: smooth, sultry male R&B tenor, silky falsetto, breathy intimate late-night delivery, light Auto-Tune sheen, laid-back behind-the-beat phrasing (2013 Atlanta R&B slow jam)
style.backups: the SAME lead voice stacked 3-6 times with harmonies, answering the lead (call-and-response)
style.rap: laid-back, conversational, punchline-driven NY rap flow, two lines per bar, relaxed confidence
style.track: 2013 Atlanta R&B slow jam, 61.5 BPM half-time (123 BPM double-time hi-hats), A major, sparse 808 kick, finger snaps, lush pads, sensual
